title: The Seed of the Woman
anchor_kjv: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
thread: In Eden, God's first word after the fall is not a threat to the guilty couple - it is a promise of rescue, spoken to the serpent: the woman's seed will crush the enemy's head, though his own heel is bruised. Fulfilled at the cross.
